title: MolliCraft2
description: The modpack used for the MolliCraft server.
body:
MolliCraft2 is the modpack used for the MolliCraft survival multiplayer server, focusing on overhauling the design of Minecraft's world and giving players more content to explore. Content from versions post-1.21.1 has been backported, various features that complement base game content have been added, and the dimensions available in Minecraft have all been overhauled, all through a collection of carefully selected mods.

While you're free to use this pack for your own experience, it was custom-made for use by my whitelisted server, and as such may contain inside jokes and references that you don't get if you aren't a part of it.
